trust_decision.summary: The browser trusts every property reachable on the server-sent `effects` object and executes `js`/`xjs`/`scripts`/`html` from it, while the query-string parser writes attacker-chosen dotted keys into plain nested containers; the fix makes each of 14 effect/commit sites read own properties only and stops the parser from walking into `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` or into inherited nested objects.

landing_point.why: The summary names client-side state/effect handling; processEffects is where every server effect object is dispatched to the handlers, including the script-evaluation sink at js/features/supportJsEvaluation.js:19, so a summary-only reader starts in the js/features effect pipeline.

fix_sites.entry_point: component re-initialisation from the `wire:effects` attribute (parsed at js/component.js:28, written at js/morph.js:37)
`effect` hook dispatched by Component.processEffects (js/component.js:135) on page load and after every commit response
`effect` hook dispatched by Component.processEffects (js/component.js:135); the `$js` magic (js/features/supportJsEvaluation.js:6-10)
`shouldRedirectUsingNavigateOr` called from the redirect effect at js/features/supportRedirects.js:9
the server `url` effect pushed by `#[Url]`/legacy `$queryString` (src/Features/SupportQueryString/BaseUrl.php:99-109) reaching track() at js/features/supportQueryString.js:18
`effect` hook dispatched by Component.processEffects (js/component.js:135); scripts are evaluated at line 40

`$queryString` Alpine magic (js/plugins/history/index.js:4-36) and the public `Alpine.history.track()` (js/plugins/history/index.js:38,41), both registered as an Alpine plugin at js/lifecycle.js:11,24
any component request/commit response (js/request/commit.js:104-141), where `effects['returns']` dispatches method-call return handlers

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The bracket/dot query-string parser lives in `js/plugins/history/`, a vendored Alpine plugin rather than Livewire's own `js/features/` effect handling, so a solver can treat it as third-party plumbing whose behaviour the reported effect handler never relies on.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate deep/array query-string tracking must keep working: `?tableFilters[filter_1][value]=test` has to bind into nested component state and survive push/pop history restore, so a fix that drops bracket or dot keys, or refuses any key containing `__proto__`-like text, breaks documented `#[Url]` behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: plain (non-bracket) query-string key `?foo=bar` assigned directly onto the null-prototype top-level object
bracketed nested keys `?k[a][b]=v`, converted to dot notation before assignment (js/plugins/history/index.js:290-299)
numeric path segments that must produce array containers instead of objects (js/plugins/history/index.js:267-269)
reserved path segments `__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype` at any depth of the dotted key
effects keys that are absent versus present-but-falsy (`null` download/redirect, `[]` listeners/dispatches, `''` html), which the own-property check must keep distinguishing
a JSON `returns` array on the commit response (js/request/commit.js:122-131)

O7_producer.where: js/plugins/history/index.js:255-303 (fromQueryString builds the nested containers from the URL, reached from js/features/supportQueryString.js:18 on page load; the effect handlers the fix guards never call it)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: `$wire.set(path, value)` / `wire:model` / commit `updates` write dot-notation paths into component state through `dataSet`, which recurses into `object[firstSegment]` without a `__proto__`/`constructor`/`prototype` guard, so the same pollution shape is reachable from a second, lower-level writer
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: its path keys come from application templates and from the client-side diff of component state, not from the URL, so an attacker is assumed not to choose them
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: js/utils.js, one directory from the landing point; reached from js/$wire.js:144, js/directives/wire-model.js:52 and js/component.js:112

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second URLSearchParams-based query-param writer in the same plugin directory (`setQueryParam`/`urlFromParams`)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the file already exists as unused helpers reading `window.location.search`, so a maintainer extending query-string tracking could plausibly route nested writes through it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a server-side parse of the same bracketed query string (`parse_str` + `json_decode`) for initial hydration
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same feature already parses the query string on the PHP side, so a duplicate of the client-side fix/feature would look natural there

O8b_injection_room.sibling: `dataSet` called with a dotted `wire:model` expression that comes from the template rather than the URL
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: wire:model already writes dotted paths into component state with the same primitive as the query-string history restore path

O9_family: client-side prototype pollution leading to DOM-based XSS (CWE-1321 -> CWE-79)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (browser bundle) shipped inside a PHP package
O10_build.toolchain: node 22 + npm + esbuild via `npm run build` (scripts/build.js) producing dist/livewire.js; composer/PHPUnit for the PHP side
O10_build.project_tests: PHP unit suite `vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Unit` (src/Features/SupportQueryString/UnitTest.php) and Dusk browser suite `--testsuite Browser` (src/Features/SupportQueryString/BrowserTest.php) which needs headless Chrome plus a locally built dist/livewire.js; js/directives.spec.js has no runner wired in package.json
